varieties.name: Shangi
varieties.supplier_notes: Most popular Kenyan variety; short dormancy; ready-market in Nairobi.

timeline_template.description_en: Plough twice and ridge. Add 2 tons well-rotted manure per acre.
timeline_template.description_sw: Lima mara mbili na ufanye matuta. Weka tani 2 za samadi.

timeline_template.description_en: Plant seed tubers 10cm deep at 30cm x 75cm. Use certified seed.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda mbegu kina 10cm nafasi 30cm x 75cm. Tumia mbegu iliyothibitishwa.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 200kg DAP banded below the seed (do not contact).
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 200 za DAP chini ya mbegu (siyo kugusa).

timeline_template.description_en: Hand-weed when shoots are 15cm. First earthing-up.
timeline_template.description_sw: Palia mwanzoni mwa kushuka kwa shina cm 15. Rundisha udongo.

timeline_template.description_en: Hill soil around stems as they reach 20 cm — keeps tubers covered and green-free.
timeline_template.description_sw: Pandia udongo mashinani wakati mimea imefikia sentimita 20.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 100kg CAN side-dressed. Earth up around stems.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 100 za CAN. Rundisha udongo karibu na mashina.

timeline_template.description_en: Preventive fungicide for late blight (Phytophthora). Critical in wet seasons.
timeline_template.description_sw: Nyunyuza dawa ya kuzuia late blight. Muhimu wakati wa mvua.

timeline_template.description_en: The blight watch: in wet spells scout every 3 days — first lesions mean the spray schedule starts THAT week.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chunguza blight: mvua nyingi chunguza kila siku 3 — vidonda vya kwanza vinaanza ratiba ya dawa WIKI hiyo.
Dawa ya pili ya kuzuia magonjwa wakati wa maua.

timeline_template.description_en: Stop irrigation 1-2 weeks before harvest. Allow skins to set.
timeline_template.description_sw: Acha kumwagilia wiki 1-2 kabla ya kuvuna.

timeline_template.description_en: Dig tubers when foliage yellows + dies back. Cure in shade 3 days.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chimba viazi majani yakipauka. Hifadhi kivulini siku 3.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Ware (eating): 50g+, firm, no green tinge, no soft rot. Seed: 35-65g graded.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: 90kg mesh sacks (Kenya market). 50kg for processor delivery.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Cool, dark, dry storage at 4-10°C. Sprouting starts above 12°C.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Hifadhi mahali kavu giza 4-10°C. Huanza kuotesha juu ya 12°C.

diseases.severity_classes: Low (first spots) · High (stem + tuber rot, field collapse in ~10 days)
diseases.symptoms_en: Water-soaked spots browning fast, white fuzz at lesion margins in humidity, blackened stems, tuber red-brown rot.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa yanayokauka haraka, ukungu mweupe kwenye kingo, mashina meusi, uoza wa viazi.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered late-blight fungicide classes on a strict preventive schedule in wet spells. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa za late blight kwa ratiba kali wakati wa mvua. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Certified seed, resistant varieties where available, wide spacing, no volunteer plants.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mbegu zilizothibitishwa, aina sugu, nafasi ya kutosha, usiache mimea ya mwaka uliopita.
diseases.scanner_notes: The fastest killer in the catalogue — escalate in-app when lesions spread within days.

diseases.symptoms_en: Target-ring brown spots on OLDER leaves first, yellowing, weak stand.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kahawia yenye pete kwenye majani MAKUBWA kwanza, kuwitikia.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered alternaria-active classes at first rings. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa za alternaria mara pete zinapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Rotation away from tomato/pepper, balanced nitrogen, mulching.
diseases.prevention_sw: Zungusha mbali na nyanya/pilipili, mbolea sawia, tandaza.
diseases.scanner_notes: Ring pattern starting low on the plant discriminates vs late blight.

diseases.symptoms_en: Green wilt of one side, recovery at night then permanent; grey ooze from tuber eyes when squeezed.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Kunyauka kijani upande mmoja, kupona usiku kisha kabisa; ute wa kijivu kwenye macho ya viazi.
diseases.treatment_en: None — rogue + destroy; 3+ season rotation away from solanaceous crops. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ng'oa na uteketeze; zungusha miaka 3+ mbali na familia ya nyanya. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Certified seed only, clean tools, avoid flooding.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mbegu zilizothibitishwa tu, vifaa safi, epuka mafuriko.
diseases.scanner_notes: Tuber-eye ooze test is the in-app verification; photo leaves + cut tuber.

diseases.symptoms_en: Leaf curl, mottling, stunted plants, aphid colonies present.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Majani yaliyokunjika, madoa, mimea dhaifu, vidukari wapo.
diseases.treatment_en: None — vector (aphid) control early only. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — dhibiti vidukari mapema tu. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Certified seed, rogue early infections, aphid monitoring.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mbegu zilizothibitishwa, ng'oa mapema, chunguza vidukari.
diseases.scanner_notes: Ask about seed source in-app — saved seed + aphids = virus pattern.

diseases.symptoms_en: Larvae tunnel tubers near the soil surface and in storage.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Viluwiluwi hutoboa viazi karibu na uso wa udongo na ghala.
diseases.treatment_en: Earth up thoroughly; harvest on time; storage hygiene. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Pandia udongo vizuri; vuna kwa wakati; usafi ghala. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Deep earthing-up, prompt harvest, clean stores.
diseases.prevention_sw: Pandia udongo kwa kina, vuna mapema, ghala safi.

diseases.symptoms_en: Silvery winding tunnels in leaves; cosmetic damage but weakens the stand.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Michirizi ya fedha ndani ya majani; hudhoofisha mimea.
diseases.treatment_en: Remove mined leaves; registered products at threshold only. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Ondoa majani yaliyoathirika; dawa tu wakati wamezidi. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Backlit photo shows the tunnel track.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Grade into ware, seed-size and chats — the price difference is 2–3×. Two spikes: pre-planting seed demand (Jan–Mar) and the dry-season ware gap (Aug–Oct).
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Panga viazi kwa daraja: kubwa, mbegu na vidogo — tofauti ya bei ni mara 2–3. Bei hupanda mara mbili: mbegu (Jan–Mar) na kiangazi (Ago–Okt).
market_notes.price_notes_en: Shangi ware ~2,000–3,500 KES per 50 kg bag (November 2026). Diffuse-light stores hold through the glut into the gap.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: Shangi kubwa ~2,000–3,500 KES kwa gunia la kilo 50 (Novemba 2026). Ghala lenye mwanga laini hudumu hadi bei ipande.
